summary: Square Enix and Disney's action-RPG series, including mainline console games, handheld side stories, HD collections, mobile/live-service entries, and announced future titles.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts
entries.definitive_edition: Kingdom Hearts Final Mix in HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX

emulation.notes: Use native Windows. PCSX2 is historical only for original PS2/Final Mix comparison.

primary.why: The HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX PC release includes Kingdom Hearts Final Mix, which adds the extra Final Mix content and is the highest-fidelity official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Kingdom Hearts -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- on Windows, preferably the current Steam build.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD collection presentation differs from original PS2 timing and assets, but it is the most complete official route.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories
entries.definitive_edition: Re:Chain of Memories in HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX

emulation.notes: Use native Windows. mGBA is only for historical GBA comparison.

primary.version: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories HD
primary.why: The PC HD collection includes the 3D Re:Chain of Memories remake, making it the highest-fidelity official route for the game's story and systems.
primary.how_to_play: Play Re:Chain of Memories through Kingdom Hearts -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- on Windows.

entries.remaster_caveats: Choose GBA only for the original 2D version's feel.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts (V CAST)

emulation.notes: Treat as preservation-only until a reliable V CAST preservation path is sourced.

primary.why: This independently developed mobile game was released only for Verizon's V CAST service, so the original mobile release is the only sourced route.
primary.how_to_play: Preservation-only: use original V CAST-compatible hardware/service data where legally available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster or storefront route.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts II
entries.definitive_edition: Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix in HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX

emulation.notes: Use native Windows. PCSX2 is historical only for PS2 comparison.

primary.version: Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix HD
primary.why: The HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX PC release includes Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix, which adds bonus bosses, cutscenes, and other Final Mix content in the highest-fidelity official package.
primary.how_to_play: Play Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix through Kingdom Hearts -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- on Windows.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD collection presentation differs from original PS2, but it is the complete official route.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts Coded
entries.definitive_edition: Kingdom Hearts Re:coded on Nintendo DS

emulation.notes: Use DS emulation with a legally dumped copy for the full playable game.

primary.why: The Nintendo DS remake is the complete playable version available internationally; later HD collections include Re:coded as cinematics rather than a playable game.
primary.how_to_play: Play Kingdom Hearts Re:coded on Nintendo DS or via melonDS/DeSmuME with a legally dumped copy.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD 2.5/1.5+2.5 versions are movies, not playable versions.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts Mobile

emulation.notes: Treat as preservation-only until a reliable mobile-service preservation path is sourced.

primary.why: This was a Japan-only social gaming service tied to avatars and minigames, so the original mobile service is the only sourced route.
primary.how_to_play: Preservation-only: use original compatible Japanese mobile/service data where legally available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster or storefront route.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days

emulation.notes: Use DS emulation with a legally dumped copy for the full playable game.

primary.why: The Nintendo DS release is the complete playable game; HD collections contain a remastered movie version rather than playable missions.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Nintendo DS or via melonDS/DeSmuME with a legally dumped copy.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD 1.5/1.5+2.5 versions are movies, not playable versions.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep
entries.definitive_edition: Birth by Sleep Final Mix in HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX

emulation.notes: Use native Windows. PPSSPP is historical only for PSP comparison.

primary.version: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix HD
primary.why: The PC HD collection includes Birth by Sleep Final Mix, bringing the expanded version to the highest-fidelity official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Birth by Sleep Final Mix through Kingdom Hearts -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- on Windows.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD version changes the original PSP presentation, but is the complete official route.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
entries.definitive_edition: Dream Drop Distance HD in HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue

emulation.notes: Use native Windows. Citra is historical only for original 3DS comparison.

primary.version: Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD
primary.why: The HD 2.8 PC release includes a full-HD remaster of Dream Drop Distance, making it the highest-fidelity official playable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue on Windows.

entries.remaster_caveats: 3DS stereoscopic/original handheld feel is not the primary route.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts X / Union X

emulation.notes: Service ended and app delisted; revisit if an official archive route appears.

primary.why: The browser/mobile live-service game transitioned and later shut down/delisted, so a current playable best-version route needs source-backed preservation research.
primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a current play route until a reliable legal/offline preservation path is sourced.

entries.remaster_caveats: Some story context is represented by Kingdom Hearts X Back Cover, but that is a movie companion rather than the playable game.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts 0.2 Birth by Sleep - A Fragmentary Passage
entries.definitive_edition: HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue on Windows

primary.version: A Fragmentary Passage in HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
primary.why: A Fragmentary Passage is an original playable episode in the 2.8 collection; Windows is the highest-fidelity official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue on Windows.

entries.remaster_caveats: Bundled title rather than a standalone original release.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts III
entries.definitive_edition: Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind on Windows

primary.why: The Windows release bundles Kingdom Hearts III with the Re Mind DLC, and PC is the highest-fidelity official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind on Windows, preferably the current Steam build.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster; use the bundled Re Mind PC release.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts Dark Road

emulation.notes: Only for legally retained app installs/data.

primary.version: Kingdom Hearts Union X Dark Road offline 5.0-era app
primary.why: Dark Road received a complete offline update before the app was later delisted; Android is selected as the most practical retained-install route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally retained installed copy of the offline app; new downloads are not generally available after delisting.

entries.remaster_caveats: No console/PC remaster; app was delisted in 2024.

entries.title: Kingdom Hearts: Melody of Memory

primary.why: The Windows release is the highest-fidelity official route for the rhythm-game spin-off.
primary.how_to_play: Play Kingdom Hearts Melody of Memory on Windows via the Epic Games Store.

entries.remaster_caveats: No Steam release is sourced as of this research pass.

primary.why: Square Enix canceled the mobile title before release, so there is no public shipped version to recommend.
primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a play route; no released build exists.

primary.why: Kingdom Hearts IV is in development, but no shipped build exists yet for a best-version recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a play route until release platforms, final content, and technical comparisons are verified after launch.
